effect.ru: Дифференциал легче разблокируется: меньше недостаточной на газу и в середине поворота.
effect.en: The diff unlocks more easily: less understeer on the power and mid-corner.

tradeoff.ru: Заднюю ось легче провернуть на выходе.
tradeoff.en: The rear can step out more easily on exit.

source.quote: Higher values produce more locking force in the differential in all conditions, producing more understeer under acceleration and deceleration. This value will also affect mid-corner performance, with higher values not allowing the differential to unlock as much, increasing mid-corner understeer.

effect.ru: Больше блокировки: машина спокойнее на газу и при сбросе газа.
effect.en: More locking: the car is calmer on and off the power.

source.quote: Higher values produce more locking force in the differential in all conditions, producing more understeer under acceleration and deceleration.

effect.ru: Больше расхождения спереди: острее вход в поворот.
effect.en: More front toe-out: a sharper turn-in.

tradeoff.ru: Хуже на прямой; перебор перегревает передние шины и даёт внезапную недостаточную.
tradeoff.en: Less straight-line stability; too much overworks the fronts and causes sudden understeer.

source.quote: More net toe-out will destabilize the car in a straight line and help with turn-in but increases slip angle on the front wheels and can risk over-slipping the front tires, which can result in sudden understeer when cornering.

effect.ru: Расхождение сзади помогает входу и перекладкам.
effect.en: Rear toe-out helps turn-in and direction changes.

source.quote: At the rear, toe-out will help with turn in and direction changes, while toe-in will increase straight-line stability.

effect.ru: Схождение сзади стабилизирует машину на газу.
effect.en: Rear toe-in steadies the car on the power.

source.quote: For short tracks or tracks where traction is a problem, setting both rear wheels toed to the left (positive right-rear and negative left-rear) can help to straighten the car on throttle application.

effect.ru: Меньше кастера слева — машину тянет влево, ей легче поворачивать на овале.
effect.en: Less left-front caster pulls the car left, which helps it turn on an oval.

tradeoff.ru: Руль легче, меньше устойчивость на прямой.

source.quote: Running less caster on the left-front will cause the vehicle to pull to the left, a desirable effect on ovals.

effect.ru: Баланс тормозов назад: машина охотнее поворачивает на торможении, передние меньше блокируются.
effect.en: Brake bias rearward: the car rotates more on the brakes and the fronts lock less.

tradeoff.ru: Слишком назад — машина нестабильна на торможении.
tradeoff.en: Too far back makes the car unstable under braking.

source.quote: A higher number equates to more braking power at the front wheels, too much and you will struggle to rotate the car on the brakes and encounter understeer, too far rearwards and the car will be unstable during the braking phase.

effect.ru: Баланс тормозов вперёд: зад спокойнее на торможении.
effect.en: Brake bias forward: the rear is calmer under braking.

source.quote: too far rearwards and the car will be unstable during the braking phase.
